description:
Huge progress in the world of "Noble Polyhedra" is described by Richard Elwes. Full bonus interview with Connor Hill is on Numberphile2: https://youtu.be/x6F9GOTbjLg
More links & stuff in full description below ↓↓↓

Special thanks to Connor Hill and Robert Webb.

Connor's paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28711

Robert's website (and links to his Stella software): https://www.software3d.com/

Thanks also to Ulrich Mikloweit who wished to point out the work of Jim McNeill at https://www.orchidpalms.com/polyhedra/noble/noble.html

More Richard Elwes on Numberphile: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLt5AfwLFPxWI42WXh1jnv51jHrcjatrk8

More about Richard Elwes (who is based at the University of Leeds): https://richardelwes.co.uk/
